text:
ana: Heads-up — seeing a spike of 403s for a subset of user sessions after the RBAC rename rolled last night. Thought it might be deprov but SCIM shows users still active.
kevin: Can you paste an example request id / SAML Subject? Also, which IdP (okta/azure) is this cluster using?
ana: Request id 01F8ZQ9YwL-3c in the app logs. IdP = Okta EU for these customers.
jules: I pulled the SCIM audit -> there were delayed patch events around 03:12 UTC for a few tenants. Some requests took 45s to apply.
maria: @ana any KMS errors in the proxy logs? I've seen decrypt flakey when key alias rotated.
ana: KMS decrypt logs look clean. but I see auth proxy returning 403 with message "failed to resolve role claims".
kevin: That usually means the SAML assertion's AttributeStatement didn't map to the new role name. Did the RBAC rename include an alias mapping change?
jules: It did — we renamed `eng:platform:viewer` -> `eng:platform:read-only` and added an automated backfill job but it ran after the canary.
ana: Ugh. So sessions minted before backfill are referencing old role in token cache and the runtime's role resolver rejects them.
maria: Temporary mitigation: we can enable the compatibility mapping in the role-resolver for 24h to accept both names. I can flip a flag in prod.
ana: Please do. Also need audit logs for affected tenants to see user IDs and session ids.
kevin: On it — I'll run queries on the token cache and produce a list. If needed we can trigger a soft-reissue of tokens by bumping session TTLs.
jules: For long-term, we should modify the SCIM backfill to run pre-rollout or keep the alias mapping in place for 7 days and emit an audit event when role canonicalization happens.
maria: Flipped compatibility flag (feature-role-compat) in prod to true. ✅
sre-bot: deploy: feature-role-compat -> prod succeeded (ver=2026.03.21-1723) :rocket:
ana: Confirmed 403s dropped to baseline within 3m, users logging in again.
kevin: I'll still collect KMS rotation timeline and SCIM events for compliance. We should document this in the postmortem.
jules: Filing a short postmortem draft and RFC for role rename process. cc @maria @ana
ana: Thanks — leaving this thread open for any late errors. If anyone sees edge tenants that still fail paste logs here.
kevin: Added the token-cache dump to the incident folder and ACLs. Will share link in #postmortems after redaction.
maria: Noted — will follow up with a checklist: (1) pre-rollout map (2) backfill dry-run (3) KMS alias window (4) monitor alerts.
ana: Great. Closing from ops perspective once I get the final tenant list. :thumbsup:
